## Symptoms
p95 latency of POST /orders rises. Error rate stays flat and submissions still return 202.

## Likely causes
1. The pricing quote call is slow but still under the timeout.
2. The order service is under CPU or connection pressure.

## How to confirm
Compare latency of the quote call with total submit latency using a trace. If the quote dominates, the pricing service is slow.

## Fix options
Investigate the pricing service saturation. Scale it if CPU bound.

## Escalate when
Latency approaches the client timeout.
